seoTitle: How to Add a Calendar to Notion Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to add a calendar block to any Notion page, embed it on a dashboard, and link it to a database for better project tracking.
intro: Adding a calendar to Notion helps visualize deadlines and events alongside your existing tasks and projects. This guide covers creating a calendar block, embedding it on a page or dashboard, and linking it to a database for more structured project management.

steps.heading: Add a calendar block
steps.body: Use Notion's block menu to insert a calendar directly into a page, which you can then populate with dates and events.

steps.heading: Embed and display the calendar on any page
steps.body: Position the calendar block wherever it's most useful, whether that's a standalone page or alongside other content.

steps.heading: Link the calendar to your dashboard
steps.body: Embed the calendar view within a broader dashboard page so it sits alongside your other tracked information at a glance.

steps.heading: Integrate it with a database
steps.body: Convert a database into a calendar view so items with due dates automatically appear on the calendar, keeping everything connected to one source of data.

steps.heading: Use it for project management
steps.body: Combine the calendar with tags, statuses, or filters from your database to track deadlines across multiple projects in one visual view.

faq.question: Is the Notion calendar feature free?
faq.answer: Yes, calendar views and blocks are available on Notion's free plan, though advanced database features may vary by plan.

faq.question: Can I turn an existing database into a calendar view?
faq.answer: Yes, Notion lets you add a calendar view to any existing database that has a date property, showing items by their due date.

faq.question: Does the calendar update automatically when I add new tasks?
faq.answer: Yes, if the calendar is linked to a database, new items with a date property will automatically appear on the calendar.

faq.question: Can I have multiple calendars on one Notion dashboard?
faq.answer: Yes, you can embed multiple calendar views from different databases on the same dashboard page.
